checks.name: SR2_homogeneous_solutions
checks.detail: exponential ansatz e^{lam sigma} on sigma > 0: the 4 x 3 system has a non-trivial solution only for lam = ['6*H'], the difference mode (alpha', beta', nu') ~ ['-1', '1', '0'] e^{6H sigma}: it grows away from the fold (mirror: e^{6H|sigma|}); no bounded static first-order correction exists when the bulk medium does not respond

checks.name: SR3_linear_junction
checks.detail: kappa delta S (space, time, extra) = {'space': '5*ja/8 + 15*jb/16 + jn/16', 'time': '3*ja/16 + 3*jb/16', 'extra': '15*ja/16 + 5*jb/8 + jn/16'} from the junction potential, equal to the coefficients of the second derivatives; the difference mode (1,-1,0) gives {'space': '-5/16', 'time': '0', 'extra': '5/16'} (no energy, opposite stresses), the radion mode (1,-1,5) gives {'space': '0', 'time': '0', 'extra': '5/8'}: it changes only the extra-time component

checks.name: SR4_radion_condition
checks.detail: to leading order in eps_r the (4,4) and (i,i) components are 3H4^2 = kappa4 rho and 2H4' + 3H4^2 = -kappa4 p (general relativity), and the extra-time component adds q + (rho - 3p)/2 = 0 (q = <L_fold>, the on-shell Lagrangian): {'radiation (q = 0)': '0', 'dust, classical (q = -rho)': '-rho/2', 'dust, q = 0': 'rho/2', 'vacuum energy (p = q = -rho)': 'rho'}

checks.name: SR5_rigid_medium_modifies_expansion
checks.detail: with a rigid bulk medium: 5H4' + 9H4^2 = -kappa4(p + q); {'radiation (q = 0)': '1/2', 'dust, classical (q = -rho)': '5/6', 'dust, q = 0': '5/9', 'vacuum energy (p = q = -rho)': '5/3'} (general relativity: radiation t^{1/2}, dust t^{2/3}, vacuum energy H4' = 0)

checks.name: SR6_radion_response_today
checks.detail: a radion mode with jumps c(1, -1, 5) gives kappa delta S^(r)_(r) = 5/8 c; the mismatch today is Delta = 0.793 rho_c (dark matter q = 0, baryons q = -rho, vacuum energy q = -rho); the response c/H = 3.806 A^2/eps_r is a small term of the power series if A^2 = (H4/H)^2 << eps_r
